description: This file defines the EndsWithBinary class, a Twig node representing a binary expression that checks if a string ends with a specified suffix. It contains methods to compile this expression into executable PHP code.

classes.name: EndsWithBinary
classes.description: A class representing a binary expression node in Twig that evaluates whether a string ends with a given suffix.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to evaluate the 'ends with' string condition, ensuring both operands are strings and applying PHP's str_ends_with function.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns raw compiler output; in this case, an empty string.
